xmldoc.short_description: Opens a color selection dialog box.

param_input_item.param_description: Initial RGB color vector with values between 0 and 1. If omitted, white is used.

param_output_item.param_description: Selected 1-by-3 RGB color vector, or 0 when canceled.

description.p: uisetcolor returns a color selected by the user.

example_item.example_item_description: Preview a color selection dialog layout.
Choose a color with a custom title.
example_item.example_item_data: c = uisetcolor([1 0 0], 'Choose highlight color'); if ~isequal(c, 0), disp(c); end
